method: The full-resolution scan's engraved coordinate labels were read directly. Each retained graticule crossing was then measured individually because the scan is slanted and the automatic regular-lattice detector was inadequate. Folds, hatching, boundaries, text strokes and neatlines were excluded before roles were assigned.
qa_review: Four engraved meridian labels and two engraved parallel labels were independently readable. Individual intersection pixels retain the scan's slant instead of flattening it. Detector candidates near x=6173 and x=8011 were true meridians; candidates near x=1371/1476 and x=9650/9760 were borders or neatlines, and x=5336 was a linen fold. Horizontal candidates near y=1001/1115 and y=6589/6718 were borders or neatlines. Linen folds near the true rules, lithology hatching, shoreline or survey boundaries, text strokes and decorative rules were excluded.
